recent_reviews.author: Farid M.
recent_reviews.text: Food ok but Google said open, reached at 4pm already closed. Please update your hours.

recent_reviews.author: Mei Ling C.
recent_reviews.text: Old-school kopitiam vibe. The kaya toast is good, kopi a bit sweet for me.

proposal.description: Family-run kopitiam in SS2 since 1998. Kopi O and teh tarik pulled the traditional way, charcoal-toasted roti bakar with homemade kaya, half-boiled eggs and nasi lemak ayam every morning. Air-conditioned seating at the back. Open daily from 7 AM.

posts.text: New: iced kopi O kosong and kaya butter toast set, RM6.90 before 10 AM.
Open on Deepavali morning, 7 AM to 12 PM. Selamat Hari Deepavali!

illustrative_reviews.author: Aisyah R.
illustrative_reviews.text: Best kopi O in SS2! Roti bakar crispy, half-boiled eggs perfect every time. Uncle Lim remembers my order and service is fast even at the 8 AM rush.
illustrative_reviews.owner_reply: Terima kasih Aisyah! See you tomorrow for your kopi O. Uncle Lim

illustrative_reviews.author: Jason T.
illustrative_reviews.text: Nasi lemak sambal is legit, not too sweet. Aircond section at the back is a bonus. Parking tough on weekdays but worth it.
illustrative_reviews.owner_reply: Thanks Jason! Try the mee goreng mamak next time. Uncle Lim
